description: Document similarity and near-duplicate detection: compare two texts (a, b) or cluster up to 200 texts. Metrics: TF-IDF cosine on stemmed content words, word Jaccard, k-word shingle Jaccard and containment, 64-bit SimHash with Hamming distance, and character edit ratio for short texts, plus a verdict (identical / near-duplicate / similar / related / different). Batch mode returns the most similar pairs and duplicate clusters. Offline, deterministic. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-similarity
